title: Gripsholm Castle
visualBrief: Mapped Gripsholm brick castle with open inner and outer courts, four differentiated oxidized-copper tower caps, a tall open lantern, broad red helmet tower, onion cap, stepped brick dormers, low tiled wings and a real northwest entrance passage.
